## 3dslibris 3.2.0

This update adds selectable control schemes (the asked one-handed), and fixes opening books from library search and some more issues.

I'm releasing this together with 3.1.2, so read the 3.1.2 release notes for the full list of changes since 3.1.1.

### New

- [#183](https://github.com/RigleGit/3dslibris/issues/183): control schemes. The settings `controls (vertical)` and `controls (horizontal)` each choose between `Default` and `One-handed`, so portrait and landscape can use different schemes. 
  - In `One-handed`, a tap on D-Pad Left (vertical) or D-Pad Up (horizontal) toggles the bookmark, and holding it enters link and image selection. While selecting, the D-Pad moves the selection and D-Pad Right (vertical) or D-Pad Down (horizontal) opens the selected link or image. L and R leave the selection, and bookmark jumps move to the Circle Pad.

### Fixes and improvements

- Library search: tapping or pressing A on an EPUB, MOBI or FB2 result now opens the book (There was a bug that made it not work for some books).
- Settings: `reset settings` now also resets the colour theme everywhere.
- Library: tapping a book or folder now opens it right away instead of needing a second tap.
  - Touch and hold a cell to select it and see its full title on the top screen without opening it; dragging off the cell cancels.
- Layout improvements:
  - Long titles and paths no longer run past their boxes.
  - Settings rows keep both lines inside the border.
  - Search results, the chapter index, book information and font file names wrap their full text and grow or paginate to fit.
  - The library list shows up to three lines per title, and the selected list row scrolls its title when it still does not fit.
- **Faster first opening of MOBI, FB2 and EPUB books**: the progress screen is repainted far less often, and MOBI and FB2 caches are written in larger blocks. Measured my consoles:
  - **Old 3DS**: a 2.9 MB MOBI drops from 46.5 s to 20.8 s (**−55%**), a 2 MB FB2 from 35.5 s to 15.9 s (**−55%**), a long EPUB from about 13 s to 9.8 s (**−25%**), and small MOBI and FB2 books open about 40% faster (3.6 → 2.0 s and 2.6 → 1.6 s).
  - **New 3DS**: the 2.9 MB MOBI drops from 16.5 s to 12.5 s (**−24%**), a 10 MB MOBI from 45.8 s to 27.9 s (**−39%**), and small books open about 25% faster.
  - Opening a book again from its cache still takes well under a second.
- **Very large MOBI books now open on the Old 3DS**: previously, large MOBI files (around 10 MB) caused the homebrew to crash on launch. Now, when a MOBI file exceeds the Old 3DS memory, it is processed in chunks using a temporary file on the SD card. 
  - This initial load is slow, but it works.

### Downloads

- `3dslibris.cia` or `3dslibris.3dsx` for normal use.
- `3dslibris-sdmc.zip`: runtime files for Homebrew Launcher installs; use with the `.3dsx` download.
- Debug builds (`3dslibris-debug.cia` / `3dslibris-debug.3dsx`) and `3dslibris-source.tar.gz` are also included.

Thanks to everyone trying the builds and reporting issues. You can support the project with a ⭐ on GitHub or [a coffee](https://ko-fi.com/rigle).
